title: Joshua 20
paragraphs: ¹ The LORD said to Joshua, ² "Tell the Israelites: 'Designate the cities of refuge that I instructed you to set apart through Moses, ³ so that anyone who kills a person accidentally and unintentionally may flee there. These cities will be a refuge from the avenger of blood. ⁴ When the fugitive flees to one of these cities, he is to stand at the entrance of the city gate and state his case before the elders of that city. They are to admit him into the city and give him a place to live among them. ⁵ If the avenger of blood comes after him, they must not hand him over, because he killed his neighbor accidentally and without prior malice.

⁶ He is to stay in that city until he has stood trial before the assembly and until the death of the high priest who is serving at that time. Then he may return home to the town he fled from.' " ⁷ So they set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath-arba — that is, Hebron — in the hill country of Judah. ⁸ East of the Jordan, on the other side from Jericho, they designated Bezer in the desert plateau from the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead from the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan from the tribe of Manasseh. ⁹ These were the cities designated for all the Israelites and for the foreigners living among them, so that anyone who killed a person accidentally could flee there and not be killed by the avenger of blood before standing trial before the assembly.
